Contract LoanProcessingSystemSystem::closeOutLoan(loanid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loan: Loan = Loan.allInstance()->any(o|o.LoanID = loanid)
	precondition:
		Loan.allInstance()->includes(loan) and
		loan.Status = LSOPEN
	postcondition:
		loan.Status = CLOSED and
		result = true
}
